title: Employ staff under the Health Professionals and Support Services Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Health Professionals and Support Services Award 2020.

laws.title: Health Professionals and Support Services Award 2020

sources.title: Health Professionals and Support Services Award 2020
sources.quote: (a) employers throughout Australia in the health industry and their employees in the classifications listed in Schedule A —Classification Definitions to the exclusion of any other modern award;

reach.note: Employers delivering health care, medical and dental services (cl 4.2). National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Health Professionals and Support Services Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 The health industry means employers whose business and/or activity is in the delivery of health care, medical services and dental services .

reach.note: Employers delivering health care, medical and dental services (cl 4.2). Unincorporated employers outside WA (in WA they are in the state system).

sources.title: Health Professionals and Support Services Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 The health industry means employers whose business and/or activity is in the delivery of health care, medical services and dental services .

confidence_note: Covers practice staff and health professionals; the Medical Practitioners Award 2020 (MA000031) lists hospitals and similar settings, not general practices, so employed GPs in private practice are likely award-free (to confirm).

assessment.summary: The Health Professionals and Support Services Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.

assessment.confidence_note: Economic reasoning and desk research only; no evaluation of this requirement found. Drafted 7 Nov 2026, not yet checked.
